 Justice S.K. Sahoo
 Order
Order No. 21.04.2023
01.

This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

This is an application under section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail to the petitioner in connection with Pattapur P.S. Case No.267 of 2022 corresponding to G.R. Case No. 260 of 2022 pending in the Court of learned Nyayadhikari, Gram Nayalaya -cum- J.M.F.C., Sankhemundi, Ganjam for alleged commission of offences under sections 419/420/420/467/468/471/ 120-B/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

The petitioner moved an application for bail before the Court of learned 1st Addl. Sessions Judge, //
2 // Berhampur, Ganjam, which was rejected on 16.03.2023.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner is in judicial custody since 24.02.2023, the offences are triable by Magistrate and the petitioner is a witness to the forged sale deed and similarly situated co-accused persons have already been granted bail by a coordinate Bench of this Court in BLAPL No. 9676 of 2022, BLAPL No. 9890 of 2022 and BLAPL No. 9892 of 2022 and therefore, the bail application of the petitioner may be favourably considered.
Learned Kalu Charan Gouda vs State Of Odisha ....

counsel files the bail order copies of the co-accused persons, which are taken on record.
Learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer for bail.

Considering the submissions of the learned counsel for the respective parties, the nature of accusation against the petitioner, the offences are triable by Magistrate and release of co-accused on bail and further taking into account the period of detention of the petitioner in judicial custody, I am inclined to release the petitioner on bail.

Let the petitioner be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing bail bond of Rs.50,000/-
(rupees fifty thousand) with two local solvent sureties each for the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Court in seisin over the matter with such // 3 // terms and conditions as the learned Court may deem just and proper including the conditions that the petitioner shall not indulge in any criminal activities, shall appear before the learned trial Court when the case would be posted for trial and shall not try to tamper with the prosecution witnesses.
Violation of any of the conditions shall entail cancellation of bail.
BLAPL is accordingly disposed of.
Issue urgent certified copy as per Rules.
( S.K. Sahoo) Judge PKSahoo Kalu Charan Gouda vs State Of Odisha ....
